items: A sudden change in the hip

caption:
Hip replacement coming up, or just home from hospital? Here's a rough picture of the early months.

The first couple of weeks are mostly short, frequent walks and the exercises from your hospital team. After that, strength and balance work usually builds, and by weeks 6–12 many people gradually rely less on walking aids.

Everyone's timeline differs. Fitness before surgery, other health conditions and the surgical approach all play a part, and your surgeon's protocol always comes first.

Wound changes, fever or new calf swelling need prompt medical advice. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can guide your rehab alongside your surgeon's plan. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
